Initial development of the R version of the PPMT algorithm.

# Packages

```{r}
# Import the required packages
packages <- c("rmarkdown","knitr","corrplot","basicPlotteR", "MASS",
              "viridis","orthopolynom","ica","fastICA","FNN","plgp")
for (p in packages) {
  if(!require(p, character.only=TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p)
  }
  require(p, character.only=TRUE)
}
rm(packages, p)
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
panel_points <- function(x, y, ...)
{
  i <- complete.cases(cbind(x, y))
  x <- x[i]
  y <- y[i]

  z <- densCols(x, y, colramp=colorRampPalette(c("black", "white")))
  cols <- viridis(256)

  df <- data.frame(x, y)
  df$dens <- col2rgb(z)[1,] + 1L
  df$col <- cols[df$dens]
  df$pch <- 20

  o <- order(df$pch, -df$dens, decreasing=TRUE)
  df <- df[o,]

  points(y~x, data=df, pch=pch, col=col, cex=1.2)
}

panel_cor <- function(x, y, digits=2, prefix="", cex.cor=1.6, ...)
{
  usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr=usr))
  par(usr=c(0, 1, 0, 1))
  r <- cor(x, y, use="complete.obs")
  txt <- format(c(r, 0.123456789), digits=digits)[1]
  txt <- paste(prefix, txt, sep="")
  text(0.5, 0.5, txt, cex=1.3)
}

panel_hist <- function(x, ...)
{
  usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr=usr))
  par(usr=c(usr[1:2], 0, 1.5) )
  h <- hist(x, plot=FALSE)
  breaks <- h$breaks; nB <- length(breaks)
  y <- h$counts; y <- y/max(y)
  rect(breaks[-nB], 0, breaks[-1], y, col="black")
}
```

```{r}
nscore0 <- function(x) {
  y <- qqnorm(x, plot.it=FALSE)$x
  trn.table <- data.frame(x=sort(x), score=sort(y))
  y <- list(score=y, trn.table=trn.table,
            min=max(0, min(x, na.rm=TRUE)-sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)), max=max(x, na.rm=TRUE)+sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))
  return (y)
}

# ltail, utail options:
#   1 = linear interpolation
#   2 = power model interpolation
#   4 = hyperbolic model interpolation (only for upper tail)
backtr0 <- function(y, x, x.nscore, zmin, zmax,
                    ltail=1, ltpar=1, utail=1, utpar=1) {
  powint <- function(xlow, xhigh, ylow, yhigh, xval, pow) {
    if((xhigh-xlow) < 1.0e-20) {
      z <- (yhigh + ylow) / 2.0
    } else {
      z <- ylow + (yhigh-ylow) * (((xval-xlow)/(xhigh-xlow))^pow)
    }
    return(z)
  }

  nt <- length(x)
  if(y <= x.nscore[1]) {
    bktr <- x.nscore[1]
    cdflo <- pnorm(x.nscore[1])
    cdfbt <- pnorm(y)
    if (ltail == 1) {
      bktr <- powint(0.0, cdflo, zmin, x[1], cdfbt, 1.0)
    } else if (ltail == 2) {
      cpow <- 1.0 / ltpar
      bktr <- powint(0.0, cdflo, zmin, x[1], cdfbt, cpow)
    }
  } else if(y >= x.nscore[nt]) {
    bktr = x[nt]
    cdfhi  = pnorm(x.nscore[nt])
    cdfbt  = pnorm(y)
    if(utail == 1) {
      bktr = powint(cdfhi, 1.0, x[nt], zmax, cdfbt, 1.0)
    } else if(utail == 2) {
      cpow   = 1.0 / utpar
      bktr = powint(cdfhi, 1.0, x[nt], zmax, cdfbt, cpow)
    } else if(utail == 4) {
      lambda <- (x[nt]^utpar) * (1.0 - cdfhi)
      bktr <- (lambda / (1.0 - cdfbt))^(1.0 / utpar)
    }
  } else {
    j <- findInterval(y, x.nscore)
    j <- max(min((nt-1), j), 1)
    bktr <- powint(x.nscore[j], x.nscore[j+1], x[j], x[j+1], y, 1.0)
  }

  return(bktr)
}

nsbacktr0 <- function(y, nscore) {
  sapply(y, backtr0, nscore$trn.table$x, nscore$trn.table$score,
         nscore$min, nscore$max)
}
```

# Load data

```{r}
data(jura, package="gstat")
df <- jura.pred
df_flds <- c("Cd","Co","Cr","Cu","Ni","Pb","Zn")
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 3
#| fig.width: 3
#| fig.cap: "Correlation plot of Jura assay data."
x <- df[, df_flds]
y <- cor(x, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(y, tl.cex=0.7, tl.col="black", insig="blank")
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 6.7
#| fig.width: 6.7
#| fig.cap: "Pairs plot of Jura assay data."
pairs(df[, df_flds], upper.panel=panel_cor, diag.panel=panel_hist, lower.panel=panel_points)
```

# Normal score

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 8

x <- df$Cd
z <- nscore0(x)

set.seed(1)
y <- seq(-5.2, 5.2, by=0.001)
x <- nsbacktr0(y, nscore=z)

par(mfcol=c(1,2))
plot(x, y, xlab="Cd", ylab="Score")
plot(y, x, ylab="Cd", xlab="Score")
```

# PPMT

## Normal score 1

Apply normal score to data.

```{r}
x <- df[, df_flds]

z_norms1 <- lapply(x, nscore0)
z_nscore1 <- lapply(z_norms1, function(o) o$score)
z_nscore1 <- do.call("cbind", z_nscore1)
colnames(z_nscore1) <- df_flds
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 6.7
#| fig.width: 6.7
pairs(z_nscore1, upper.panel=panel_cor, diag.panel=panel_hist, lower.panel=panel_points)
```

Check normal score function.

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 8
par(mfcol=c(2,4))
for (i in 1:ncol(z_nscore1)) {
  plot(x[,i], z_nscore1[,i], pch=16, xlab=df_flds[i], ylab="z")
}
```

Check inverse normal score.

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 8
z <- sapply(1:ncol(z_nscore1), function(i) nsbacktr0(z_nscore1[,i], z_norms1[[i]]))
par(mfcol=c(2,4))
for (i in 1:ncol(z_nscore1)) {
  plot(x[,i], z[,i], pch=16, xlab=df_flds[i], ylab="z")
  abline(0, 1, col="red")
}
```

## Sphereing

```{r}
# Sphereing
z_cv <- cov(z_nscore1)
z_ei <- eigen(z_cv)
V <- z_ei$vectors
z_W <- V %*% diag(1 / sqrt(z_ei$values)) %*% t(V)
z_A <- solve(z_W)
z_sphere <- as.matrix(z_nscore1) %*% z_W
z_sphere <- as.data.frame(z_sphere)
names(z_sphere) <- df_flds
```

Check inverse.

```{r}
y <- as.matrix(z_sphere) %*% z_A
all.equal(as.numeric(y), as.numeric(as.matrix(z_nscore1)))
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 8
z <- as.matrix(z_sphere) %*% z_A
z <- as.data.frame(z)
par(mfcol=c(2,4))
for (i in 1:ncol(z_nscore1)) {
  plot(z_nscore1[,i], z[,i], pch=16, xlab=df_flds[i], ylab="z")
  abline(0, 1, col="red")
}
```

## Projection pursuit

Apply projection pursuit to normal score.

```{r}
z_pp <- fastICA(z_sphere, ncol(x), alg.typ="deflation", fun="logcosh",
                alpha=1, method="C", row.norm=FALSE, maxit=200,
                tol=1e-4, verbose=FALSE)
z_S <- as.data.frame(z_pp$S)
colnames(z_S) <- colnames(z_sphere)
```

Check inverse projection pursuit.

```{r}
all.equal(as.numeric(as.matrix(z_sphere)), as.numeric(z_pp$X))
all.equal(z_pp$X %*% z_pp$K %*% z_pp$W, z_pp$S)
all.equal(as.numeric(z_pp$S %*% z_pp$A),
          as.numeric(as.matrix(sweep(z_sphere, 2, apply(z_sphere, 2, mean)))))
```

The `fastICA` function subtracts the mean of X columns from X. This needs to be added back in order to inverse the transformation.

Apply projection pursuit to normal score.

```{r}
z_pp <-  icafast(z_sphere, ncol(z_sphere), center=FALSE, alg="def", fun="logcosh")
z_S <- as.data.frame(z_pp$S)
names(z_S) <- names(z_sphere)
```

Check inverse projection pursuit.

```{r}
all.equal(tcrossprod(as.matrix(z_sphere), z_pp$W), z_pp$S)
all.equal(as.numeric(tcrossprod(as.matrix(z_S), z_pp$M)), as.numeric(as.matrix(z_sphere)))
```

## Normal score 2

Apply normal score to projection pursuit transform.

```{r}
z_norms2 <- lapply(z_S, nscore0)
z_nscore2 <- lapply(z_norms2, function(o) o$score)
z_nscore2 <- do.call("cbind", z_nscore2)
colnames(z_nscore2) <- df_flds
```

Check normal score function.

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 8
par(mfcol=c(2,4))
for (i in 1:ncol(z_nscore2)) {
  plot(z_S[,i], z_nscore2[,i], pch=16, xlab=df_flds[i], ylab="z")
}
```

Check inverse normal score.

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 8
z <- sapply(1:ncol(z_nscore2), function(i) nsbacktr0(z_nscore2[,i], z_norms2[[i]]))
par(mfcol=c(2,4))
for (i in 1:ncol(z_nscore2)) {
  plot(z_S[,i], z[,i], pch=16, xlab=df_flds[i], ylab="z")
  abline(0, 1, col="red")
}
```

Check correlations.

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 4
x <- cor(df[, df_flds], use="complete.obs")
x <- x[lower.tri(x)]

z <- sapply(1:ncol(z_nscore2), function(i) nsbacktr0(z_nscore2[,i], z_norms2[[i]]))
z <- tcrossprod(as.matrix(z), z_pp$M)
z <- z %*% z_A
z <- sapply(1:ncol(z_nscore1), function(i) nsbacktr0(z_nscore1[,i], z_norms1[[i]]))
z <- as.data.frame(z)
names(z) <- df_flds

y <- cor(z, use="complete.obs")
y <- y[lower.tri(y)]
flds <- outer(df_flds, df_flds, paste, sep=".")
flds <- flds[lower.tri(flds)]

lim <- range(x, y)
par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 1.1, 1.1))
plot(x, y, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=lim, ylim=lim,
     xlab="Actual", ylab="Simulated")
abline(0, 1, col="red")
addTextLabels(x, y, cex.label=0.7, cex.pt=1, col.line="blue",
              col.label="blue", labels=flds, keepLabelsInside=TRUE)
```
